canonical.text: Latest tracker evidence (2026-10-26 JPM / Cardoso relaying TrendForce): Q4 conventional DRAM +10-15%, NAND +15-20% QoQ. The wiki canonical June-30 vintage (+3-8% Q4 DRAM) is historical; its prior tracker rendering is archived. Jefferies expert on Oct-22 is stronger on Q4 DRAM (nearly 20%). Bases are kept separate, never averaged.

rows.basis: sector contract-price growth; not company blended ASP or the fixed InSpectrum basket
